title: Pullback of a finite locally constant etale sheaf
statement: Let $g:Y'\to Y$ and $f:Y\to T$ be morphisms of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and let $F$ be a sheaf of abelian groups on the small etale site $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. For a morphism $h:W\to T$ write $h^{-1}F$ for the sheafification of the presheaf pullback of $F$ along the base-change functor $T_{\Et}\to W_{\Et}$, $V\mapsto V\times_TW$, as in [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and likewise $g^{-1}$ for sheaves on $Y_{\Et}$. If $f^{-1}F$ is finite locally constant on $Y_{\Et}$ in the sense of [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], then $(f\circ g)^{-1}F\cong g^{-1}(f^{-1}F)$ and this sheaf is finite locally constant on $Y'_{\Et}$.

proof.text: For an etale X-scheme U, transport G.over U along Etale.overSheafEquiv U and use overSheafEquivFunctorObjOverIso on abelian sheaves. Forgetting groups commutes definitionally with these restrictions and site-equivalence functors. Sheaf.isConstant_sheafCongr_functor_iff and the forgotten isomorphism identify constancy of the localized underlying set sheaf with constancy of the underlying set sheaf of U.hom inverse image. This is the private helper underlying_isConstant_over_iff; it does not assert that a constant underlying set sheaf is a constant abelian sheaf.

proof.text: Set pullback is left exact: unfold its sheafification-after-Kan-extension construction and apply the existing flat-functor and sheafification instances, with the universe-shrunk AB5 instance for sets. etaleInverseImageAbelianLift then supplies the isomorphism between forgetting abelian inverse image and set inverse image. For a constant set sheaf, Sheaf.isConstant_sheafPullback applies to base change because it preserves terminal objects; the constructed/abstract pullback comparison transfers this constancy to etaleSetPullback. Transport across the abelian forgetful comparison. This proves underlying_isConstant_upperStar for any constant value in Type (u+1), with no need for sections or uniqueness of the constant-sheaf comparison.

proof.text: Unpack a trivializing etale cover of the underlying set sheaf of G=f inverse image F, and pull it back using Cover.pullback2 (Lean pullback₂). Each original restriction is constant by step 2, and pulling it along the first projection stays constant by step 3. The inverse of upperStarComp for the first projection, the pullback-square equality, and upperStarComp for the second projection give an isomorphism with restriction of g inverse image G. Forget it and use Sheaf.isConstant_congr; step 2 identifies this with the required localized restriction. This proves underlying_locallyConstant_upperStar.

proof.text: For every algebraically closed geometric point s of Y-prime, compose Point.sheafFiberCompIso for forgetting groups, the forgotten component of Etale.upperStarCompSheafFiberIso g s, and the inverse forget/stalk comparison at s followed by g. The result identifies the set-valued stalk of the iterated inverse image with the finite set-valued stalk of G at s followed by g. Shrink the forgetful filtered-colimit preservation instance from u+1 to u, and apply Finite.of_equiv to this isomorphism.

proof.text: Finite local constancy is invariant under set-sheaf isomorphisms: map the isomorphism through each localized restriction and use Sheaf.isConstant_congr on the same cover; map it through each geometric fiber functor and use Finite.of_equiv. Apply this proved private helper to the forgotten inverse of c from step 1, with local constancy from step 4 and finite stalks from step 5. Pair the result with Nonempty.intro c.
